description: Texas judgment deadline clock. The Texas judgment-lifecycle clocks computed from a judgment date: the 30-day execution wait, the 10-year dormancy deadline from rendition and from a writ, the lien's 10-year anniversary from recording, the 2-year revival deadline, and the 14-day justice-court answer clock. Pure computation from the published rules — no case data stored. General information, not legal advice. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

judgment_date.description: date the judgment was rendered, YYYY-MM-DD (required)

recording_date.description: date an abstract was recorded, YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

service_date.description: date of citation service for the JP answer clock, YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

writ_date.description: date a writ of execution issued, YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

name: get_legal_deadline_clock
